title: Iran's Ministry of Intelligence: 3 agents sending information to the enemy arrested in the southeast of the country; 4 operational cells of a terrorist-Takfiri group were dismantled
text:
Iran's Ministry of Intelligence: 3 agents sending information to the enemy arrested in the southeast of the country; 4 operational cells of a terrorist-Takfiri group were dismantled"

"General Intelligence Directorate of Sistan and Baluchestan Province:"

"🔹 The officers of the Intelligence Organization, with the help of public reports, continuous intelligence and operational monitoring, and cooperation with other security forces, succeeded in identifying these 4 cells affiliated with the American-Zionist enemy in counties in the central and southern areas of the province and arresting 16 terrorists from these cells, some of whom had come from abroad."

"🔹 Some of the arrested terrorists were involved in the martyrdom of a number of devoted personnel of Iran’s Law Enforcement Command in Iranshahr County; after arrest, they were handed over to the competent judicial authorities."

"🔹 A number of weapons and combat ammunition were discovered and seized from the arrested terrorists, including 9 Kalashnikov rifles, 2 American M4 rifles, and 7 pistols, along with related ammunition."

"🔹 Also, in continuation of the blows against rootless mercenaries affiliated with the espionage-media network of the American-Zionist enemy, 3 of these mercenaries who were collecting and sending information about the locations of defense and security headquarters and facilities in the south of the province were identified and arrested."

"Iran's State TV
